hash_distance — IMGFORENSICS hash op

• Data kinds: phash × phash → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hash_distance(hash1, hash2) -> 'int' (to call the implementation directly, import imgforensics; imgforensics.hash_distance(hash1, hash2) -> 'int'; from the registry, opsimgforensics.get("hash_distance"))

Usage

Hamming distance between two perceptual hashes (the number of differing bits).

It checks dtype and length and fails closed. If a float 1-D array were accepted and counted with !=, almost certainly "all bits differ" = the maximum distance would come out, a *plausible* value —— but that is a type mix-up, not a difference between images.

The return is a Python int (measurement vocabulary). If you want the distance normalized by the bit length, hash_distance(a, b) / a.size.
